document.title: Fixture region service operation boundary
document.canonical_text: Service operation is permitted only in fixture region R1; other regions must be refused. Expansion requires a new owner decision. Deployment and isolation verification belong to one delivery boundary. Runbook implementation uses ExampleDriver 7.4.2-fixture and command examplectl deploy --region=R1.
conditions: Applies only to service operation in fixture region R1.
exceptions: Expansion requires a new owner decision.
